examples.en: People are fed up with all these traffic jams.
examples.zh: 人们厌烦这么多的交通堵塞。

examples.en: As fans rushed to leave, jams formed at all the exits.
examples.zh: 因球迷都急于离开，所有出口都给阻塞了。

examples.en: Stationary cars in traffic jams cause a great deal of pollution.
examples.zh: 交通堵塞中停止不前的车辆造成大量污染。
